links.outcome: Readability (Flesch Reading Ease, Flesch-Kincaid grade level) of GPT-4 vs Google answers to carpal tunnel surgery FAQs
links.effect: GPT-4 Flesch Reading Ease 34.19 vs Google 56.40 (P=0.001); grade level 12.85 vs 9.93 (P=0.007); GPT-4 responses longer (162.9 vs 91.5 words).
links.quote: Google's answers were more readable than GPT-4's, with a Flesch Reading Ease score of 56.40 vs. 34.19 ( P = 0.001) and a Flesch-Kincaid grade level of 9.93 vs. 12.85 ( P = 0.007).

screen.reason: Evaluates GPT-4 versus Google Search responses to carpal tunnel surgery FAQs in terms of readability and accuracy, but does not test an organizational deployment safeguard or practice.
